node: P6-N08 read-only account cost/fee summary slice
outcome: One workspace now shows exact remaining position cost, cumulative incurred simulation fees and the number of orders with fills. Cost, fees and market valuation are explicitly distinguished.

scope.writeSemantics: Display only; no additional requests, fees, fills, orders, journal entries or account writes
scope.routeDescription: Corrected the old closed-simulation description to match currently available controlled buys and read-only account reports

semantics.positionCost: Sum of current position.costAmount; already includes corresponding buy fees; not cumulative buys, market value or return.
semantics.paidFees: Sum of every order.totalFees once, including partial fills later cancelled; unfilled orders must have zero fees. Producer emits all execution.orders, without pagination or last-N truncation.
semantics.filledOrderCount: Count orders with filledQuantity > 0, including zero-fee fills. This is not the number of fill callbacks.
semantics.precision: Nonnegative decimal strings are aligned by fractional digits and added using BigInt; no binary-float money conversion.
semantics.dataValidity: Existing workspace/account/order display checks, plus unique order IDs, valid amount text, no fee without fills and no order fact after the workspace cutoff, including nanoseconds. Bad input yields an unavailable summary, never fabricated zero.
semantics.snapshot: All three values come from the same workspace object and show its generatedAt. DEGRADED retains an explicit warning. Valid empty account displays 0/0/0.

web.command: pnpm --filter @kunlun/web exec vitest run src/features/paper src/app/route-contract.test.ts

verification.static: Web tsc, scoped ESLint/Prettier and diff checks passed. Server compiled in the affected build. No redundant local Python/full-repository suite.
verification.build: One Server/Web build passed; no review fix/rebuild required. Quant image/process, database services and collectors reused unchanged.

independentReview.conclusion: Final source, exact sums, full producer order scope, paid-fee semantics, future-fact rejection, actual/fixture UI and identical ledger/journal evidence checked; no remaining blockers.

actualBrowser.account: Original existing account read only; no test trades created
